up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2C19. Return each compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (coalesce pubmed_id and doi, preferring pubmed_id), assay description, target name, and organism. Only include rows where a PubMed ID or DOI is available. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_relation = '='. Target organism must be Homo sapiens. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and docs via activities.doc_id.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Cytochrome P450 2C19'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
